title: Cornyn vs. Paxton Texas Senate Primary Runoff Draws National Attention
detail: Senator John Cornyn fights to hold his Texas Senate seat in a primary runoff against Trump-backed Ken Paxton in a closely watched race that could reshape the balance of power within the Republican Party. The contest pits Cornyn's establishment credentials against Paxton's Trump-aligned populist appeal.
